opportunities.title: Great Britain Sasakawa Foundation Small Grants – UK office (deadline 15 September 2026)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must belong to an organisation willing to receive grant funds; individuals not eligible unless they can provide organisational support.

opportunities.title: Great Britain Sasakawa Foundation Butterfield Awards – Medicine and Health (deadline 1 December 2026)

amount.raw: up to £10,000 per year, up to £30,000 total

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants should have an existing research record or be practitioners/managers in health; must involve partners in both the UK and Japan.
opportunities.summary: Awards to support exchanges and collaborations between health and medical professionals in Japan and the UK, covering scientific, clinical, social and economic issues in healthcare.
